name: AST-Aware Code Chunking
mechanism: Uses abstract syntax tree nodes to keep functions classes and other semantic code units intact, recursively splitting large nodes and merging bounded siblings.
use_when: Repositories contain supported parseable programming languages
Retrieval and generation depend on complete code structures
avoid_when: Files are generated malformed or unsupported by the AST parser
Cross-file dependency retrieval is required without symbol or graph expansion
expected_effects: More semantically coherent code retrieval units
failure_modes: Parser errors drop or misnest code
Large functions still require destructive splits
required_evals: language coverage and parse failure rate
